svg.text: A four-point star, 20 mm, off the shape tool (280 stitches in the stream)
PES: 284 needle holes, 2 the DST has not
EXP: 284 needle holes, 0 the DST has not
EXP, the other writer: 288 needle holes, 4 the DST has not
A stitch file that opens with a stitch, placed 30 mm right of the hoop's middle and 20 mm down (10 stitches in the stream)
PES: 10 needle holes, 0 the DST has not
EXP: 10 needle holes, 0 the DST has not
EXP, the other writer: 12 needle holes, 2 the DST has not
Lettering, then that stitch file as the second element (1,138 stitches in the stream)
PES: 1,138 needle holes, 0 the DST has not
EXP: 1,138 needle holes, 0 the DST has not
EXP, the other writer: 1,140 needle holes, 2 the DST has not
Each file as pystitch reads it. Blue: thread between two stitches in a row. Grey, dashed: every other move. Dot: a needle hole.
Red ring: a hole the DST of the same design has not (in a PES, a split point 0.1 mm from the DST's). Open circle: where the file starts.
